item.title: Email delivery issues with Microsoft [resolved]
item.description:
Email delivery issues with Microsoft has now been fixed, and all systems are verified to be working as expected again.
If you are still having problems accessing related services with us, please contact us on chat or email here: https://www.one.com/chat.

item.title: Email issue [investigating]
item.description:
We are currently experiencing issues with our mailservices.
Our Engineering team is doing all they can to get our systems back to normal as soon as possible. No data will be lost because of this issue.
We will keep you updated on the progress and resolution of this issue.
